answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works when being paid is priced by something fakes cannot mint. Each worker locks a stake that unlocks only after independently verifiable output, so N puppets need N funded stakes. A fake cohort earns nothing until it works for real, so the attacker pays fees, locked capital and lost yield on escrow. Pricing each seat against median honest output kills any cheap lagoon of throwaway tickets, and checking attestation with external oracles, not peers, turns a lotus of self-voting accounts into a haven of wasted spend. The cheapest path left is honest work.
